title: [GMCP 203.044.06] Operations and evidence: Inspector, debugger, record/replay, mocks, and test laboratory
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-044-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: An operator can inspect negotiated capabilities, schemas, calls, subscriptions, tasks and traces; validate a server; replay a redacted deterministic transcript; inject latency/faults; and generate configurable mock clients or servers from contracts. Sensitive fields are removed before persistence, replay cannot perform side effects by default, formats are versioned, and CLI/TUI plus official Inspector workflows agree. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
